story.en: Do your legs hurt? ...Let's go up slowly, there's no rush.

story.text: 여기가 '오목대'예요. 한옥마을 전체가 다 보이는 곳이에요.
story.reading: yeo-gi-ga 'o-mok-dae'ye-yo. han-ok-ma-eul jeon-che-ga da bo-i-neun gos-i-e-yo.
story.en: This is 'Omokdae'. A place where you can see the whole Hanok Village.

story.text: '계단' 꽤 되죠. 힘들면 말해요, 천천히 가면 되니까.
story.reading: 'gye-dan' kkwae doe-jyo. him-deul-myeon mal-hae-yo, cheon-cheon-hi ga-myeon doe-ni-kka.
story.en: Quite a lot of 'stairs', right. Tell me if it's hard, we can go slowly.

story.text: 저 '노을' 좀 봐요. 기와지붕이 다 붉게 물들었어요.
story.reading: jeo 'no-eul' jom bwa-yo. gi-wa-ji-bung-i da bulg-ge mul-deul-eoss-eo-yo.
story.en: Look at that 'sunset glow'. The tiled roofs have all turned red.
...You almost tripped. Just take my 'hand', just take it.

story.text: '바람' 차죠. …이 풍경, 나중에도 같이 보고 싶다는 생각, 방금 했어요.
story.reading: 'ba-ram' cha-jyo. …i pung-gyeong, na-jung-e-do gat-i bo-go sip-da-neun saeng-gak, bang-geum haess-eo-yo.
story.en: The 'wind' is cold, right. ...I just thought I'd like to see this view again with you, someday.

story.text: …뭘 그렇게 봐요. 그냥, 계속 이렇게 있고 싶다는 거예요.
story.reading: …mwol geu-reoh-ge bwa-yo. geu-nyang, gye-sok i-reoh-ge it-go sip-da-neun geo-ye-yo.
story.en: ...What are you looking at like that. I just mean... I want it to stay like this, for a long time.

words.example_en: I watch the sunset from Omokdae.
I go up the stairs slowly.
The sunset glow is truly beautiful.

sentences.en: There are many stairs up to Omokdae.
The wind blows as the sunset falls.
We climb the stairs holding hands.
It's a bit cold because the wind is blowing.
The sunset glow looks so warm.
